infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app requires access to your location to find nearby service providers and track bookings in real time.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: This app requires background location access to allow service providers to receive bookings and track progress.
